changes: Preserve flairr2025:refinement for the TSK forecast-error-driven refinement loop; separate GTS historical-window retrieval as flairr2025:analogue-retrieval.
Replace Control, Verification, and Feedback with Planning and Orchestration for within-session scoring, stopping, and prompt selection.
Remove Optimization and Evolution: no cross-episode improvement of reusable assets is demonstrated.
Move context_memory to the retrieval module; refinement has functions=[] and view_status=task_procedure.
Add independently contributed flairr2025:strategy-prompts as a TSK method module.
reconciliation.reason: Sections 2.1-2.2 distinguish forecast-MAE-driven prompt revision from Pearson-similarity historical retrieval; the separate retrieval and refinement ablations (lines 381-387) also support separability. Preserve the existing ID for the same refinement mechanism. The old mapped view conflated its task-specific MAE objective with the retrieved temporal context. Sections 2.3 and Appendix E explicitly contribute ASP procedures; these are proposed methods, not unchanged baselines. No model parameters are trained.

notes: No model training or learned temporal representation is contributed. StandardScaling and baseline forecasters are excluded; the forecaster call and prompt-synthesis steps are part of the refinement loop. Temporal-validity evidence concerns the ILINet/weather pretraining cutoff check, not a demonstrated guard for every retrieval or refinement sample. Algorithm 1 uses recent horizon ground truth and F.3 specifies three validation samples, but their separation from reported test targets is not fully specified. Appendix G proposes measuring refiner-feedback quality in future; this is not a reported process-validity evaluation. Reconciliation preserves the existing refinement ID while separating its retrieval integration. ASPs are included because the packet explicitly introduces and evaluates them as proposed methods (lines 66-82, 185-188, 271-272), despite their additional use as performance benchmarks.

items.result: refinement stays TSK; retrieval split out as GTS flairr2025:analogue-retrieval
items.reason: The refinement loop is bound to forecast MAE, stopping threshold and best-MAE prompt selection (R3_1 yes). Retrieval ranks sliding windows by Pearson similarity of the context window and returns segments with outcomes, with no forecast-error objective (R3_1 no) and depends on windows and order (R3_2 yes); it is separable from the refinement loop.
ASPs are introduced as proposed forecasting procedures (STL decomposition, scenario ensembles) written as prompts without parameter updates.

adjudication.summary: The candidate split of the old refinement module into a TSK refinement loop and a GTS historical-window retrieval is supported by Sections 2.1-2.2. No other change was needed.
